freeze_discipline.why: This is a deductive lane, not an empirical one. There is no outcome to access and therefore no post-outcome tuning risk of the usual kind: a theorem is valid or it is not, and its verification is exhaustive rather than sampled. Preregistration of a margin or a gate would be theatre here.
freeze_discipline.substituted_guard: A negative-control harness perturbs the claimed statement in five distinct ways and requires the checker to reject every perturbation while accepting the unperturbed statement. This is the deductive analogue of a power check: it establishes that the verification could have failed.
post_outcome_changes_forbidden: weakening a theorem statement after the checker rejects it
restricting the enumeration range to hide a counterexample
removing a negative control that fails to fire
freeze_discipline.disclosure: The proof, the checker and the negative controls were authored in a single work window. No earlier version of the claimed region was tried and discarded; the region in THEORY.md section 3 Theorem 3 is the first and only region asserted. Had it failed, the failure would have been recorded rather than the statement adjusted.

claim_under_test.informal: Inter-instrument agreement carries information about how similar two instruments' accuracies are, and no information about how accurate either is.
formal_statements: Theorem 2: (1-a)/2 <= q <= (1+a)/2, width exactly a, all values attained.
Theorem 3: attainable accuracy pairs are exactly R(a) = {(u,v) in [0,1]^2 : |u-v| <= 1-a, 1-a <= u+v <= 1+a} = conv{(1-a,0),(1,a),(a,1),(0,1-a)}.
Corollary 2.1: a=1 gives q in [0,1] - no nontrivial bound.
Corollary 2.3: interval width is exactly a, so identification power strictly decreases in agreement.
Corollary 3.2: agreement constrains neither instrument's individual accuracy.
assumptions: binary decisions and binary deferred outcome, i.e. alignment vs non-alignment against a frozen deferred map
a common finite index set of scored units
claim_under_test.scope_exclusion: Alphabets of size >= 3. Lemma 1 case 1 is false for k >= 3, where two disagreeing instruments may both be wrong. No multi-class reliability statement may cite these theorems.

independent_checker_requirements.independence_rule: The checker must not import Lemma 1, Theorem 1, Theorem 3 or any algebraic rearrangement from THEORY.md. Every observable is recomputed from its definition by counting cells of {0,1}^3.
independent_checker_requirements.arithmetic: exact rational (fractions.Fraction); floating point is forbidden

route_a.name: exhaustive finite-sample enumeration
route_a.method: enumerate every multiset of n units over the 8 cells for n = 1..7 and assert each induced (a, pX, pY) lies in the claimed region
route_a.establishes: soundness on every realizable finite sample up to n=7, which covers the n_valid=3 regime of the paper with margin

route_b.name: exact polytope vertex enumeration
route_b.method: for each a on a rational grid, enumerate the exact vertices of {p >= 0 : sum p = 1, sum_{x=y} p = a} (support <= 2 under two equality constraints), map them through p -> (pX, pY), assert every image lies in the claimed region, and assert every claimed vertex of R(a) lies in the exact convex hull of the images
route_b.establishes: both soundness and completeness of the claimed region at population level, i.e. sharpness

independent_checker_requirements.cannot_check_rule: Any inability to run must exit 3 and report status CANNOT_CHECK. Exit 3 must never be reported as a pass.

negative_controls.requirement: The checker must reject every perturbed statement and accept the unperturbed one.
negative_controls.pass_condition: 5 of 5 controls fire AND the true statement is accepted
negative_controls.rationale: Without this, a vacuous checker would be indistinguishable from a correct one.

would_license: citing an exact, assumption-free reason that agreement is not validation, in place of a single counterexample
stating precisely what inter-instrument agreement does measure, namely accuracy homogeneity
a Limitations sentence quantifying that the observed 3/3 agreement bounds mean accuracy only to [0,1]
would_not_license: any reliability estimate, kappa, calibration claim or population generalization
promoting agreement into a correctness score
any change to aggregate_accuracy_computed or aggregate_reliability_claim_authorized
any novelty claim over the underlying donor mathematics
any change to submission_tmlr/ bytes bound under issue #1601

stop_rule: This lane is complete once the theorems are proved, the independent checker passes both routes, and the negative controls fire. No empirical work follows from it. The prospective reliability series described in the candidate note remains separate successor science and is NOT a submission blocker for ORION-07.
